title: Geo
description: A WGS84 position. `cell` is the municipal grid reference, coarse enough (approximately 250 m) to remain usable in analytical retention after exact coordinates are stripped. The root schema accepts either form; analytical schemas MUST reference `#/$defs/coarse` so that precise coordinates are structurally impossible rather than merely discouraged.

accuracy_m.description: Horizontal accuracy radius in metres, 68% confidence.

coarse.title: Coarse position
coarse.description: Municipal grid cell only. Precise coordinates are not representable in this form.

cell_id.description: Municipal grid reference, approximately 250 m on a side.
